messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 6 ships Nov 21 2026; at under 12¢ power runs roughly $29 a month, cheapest per TH we sell.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is desk-sized, 15 lb, BM1370 chip; new buyers don't get the free Duster or Power Kit — those were Waves 1 and 2 only.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about ten cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $47 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: Spare room suits Turbo: 50 TH/s at 850W, about $61 a month at 10¢. Eco is 30 TH/s at 450W, ~$32, ~50 dB. Stock 40 TH/s is 650W, $47.
At your rate, the 40T runs about forty-seven dollars a month in power. At six fifty watts it puts out a lot of heat and fan noise for a desk. Could it go in a spare room?

A spare room is perfect, since its fans hum and you can close the door. It's still about forty-seven dollars a month in power. What's pulling you in? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
